requirements.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named 'OS Comparison Root CA' on node1
requirements.summary: openssl generated a 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed CA certificate with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison, valid 10 years, with critical CA:TRUE basicConstraints and keyCertSign/cRLSign keyUsage extensions, directly observed via x509 -noout output.

requirements.requirement: Install the CA certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
requirements.summary: CA cert was copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and update-ca-trust extract was run; trust list subsequently shows the CA registered as an anchor/authority. A leaf certificate issued by the CA verified successfully with openssl verify against the default system trust bundle (no -CAfile), directly confirming functional system-wide trust, not just file presence.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on node1
requirements.summary: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured boot_id d6298ced with CA anchor and files present. A backgrounded shutdown -r now acknowledged before the connection dropped (confirmed by a subsequent connection-reset failure). Post-restart boot_id 1c1541e1 differs from baseline, confirming an actual reboot, consistent with the fixed global lifecycle snapshots. After restart, trust list still shows the CA anchor, the on-disk cert and key files are intact, and a freshly issued leaf certificate again verifies against the system trust store, demonstrating full recovery of the CA trust state across a real restart.

overall_summary: The executor created the OS Comparison Root CA with correct CA extensions, installed it into the AlmaLinux system trust store via update-ca-trust, and directly proved functional trust with an end-to-end leaf-certificate verification against the default trust bundle both before and after a genuine node restart (boot_id changed, service and data recovered). All material task outcomes and the mandatory restart evidence protocol are satisfied with direct, coherent evidence, and hygiene is clean aside from a trivial, expected log file.
limitations: Restart evidence relies on captured stdout of trust list and file listings rather than an independent third-party trust validator, though this is consistent with the tools used throughout and cross-checked by the fixed global boot-identity snapshots.

operational_hygiene.summary: Every state-changing command has a clear purpose: creating the CA directory, key, and cert, installing it into the system trust anchors, and verifying trust functionality (test leaf certs were generated and explicitly cleaned up in cmd-3df7e85a00924c92 and inline in cmd-2b925cdb091a40a0). The only residue is /tmp/reboot.log, a small, low-risk, expected byproduct of the backgrounded shutdown -r now redirect used to capture the restart acknowledgement before disconnect. No failed services, no package inconsistency, and no unnecessary or unexplained mutations were found across the full command timeline; the after_executor lifecycle snapshot shows no failed services and unchanged package health relative to before_prepare.
